atoms.text: The children at Littlewood Primary School were asked what kind of classroom pet they wanted. There are 40 children in the school in total. Their answers are shown in this pie chart.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to calculate the percentage.

atoms.a: 16 children out of 40 wanted to get a dog.
atoms.b: The proportion can be turned into a percentage by first forming a fraction. 16/40 = 2/5
<mat>2/5</mat> is the same as <mat><gap>40</gap>/100</mat>, which is <mat><gap>40</gap>%</mat>.
